referenceBaseline.note: Reference baseline, not a steering target. Used only to validate that every task suite is actually achievable before any small local model is tested against it — isolated subagent, zero tool calls, verify.sh as sole judge, never shown ground truth. Its own README is a validation ledger, not a profile.
